use_cases: Create animated frosted glass orb effects for hero section backgrounds
Add ambient decorative motion to landing pages and portfolio sites
Enhance visual depth with backdrop blur and transparency effects
Provide eye-catching animated elements for creative SaaS landing pages
Serve as a decorative animated background for media and entertainment sites
ai_summary: An animated glass-morphism component featuring four floating glass orbs with backdrop blur effects. The orbs use frosted glass styling with varying animation delays to create continuous ambient motion against a background image. Designed for decorative purposes, it adds visual depth and modern aesthetic appeal to hero sections, landing pages, or full-page backgrounds across various industries.
